description: Request escrow funding for a milestone. This does NOT move money: it returns a pending approval with an approvalUrl that a signed-in human must open and confirm in the OpenTrain app (expires in ~72h). Watch opentrain_poll_updates for an approval.confirmed event, or re-check with opentrain_get_approval. Requires payments:write scope, a claimed account, and the payments-write feature flag.
name: opentrain_request_milestone_funding
